title: TikTok Hashtag Videos Scraper Input
description: Fetch videos for one or more TikTok challenge IDs in one cost-efficient run.

challenge_ids.title: Challenge IDs
challenge_ids.description: Up to 20 numeric TikTok challenge IDs. Use TikTok Challenge Search first to discover IDs.

challenge_id.title: Single Challenge ID (legacy)
challenge_id.description: Compatibility input used only when challenge_ids is empty.

region.title: Region
region.description: Optional two-letter region code, such as US.

cursor.title: Starting Cursor
cursor.description: Optional cursor applied as the starting point for each challenge.

results_per_challenge.title: Results Per Challenge
results_per_challenge.description: Maximum unique videos saved per challenge (1-500). Total requested results may not exceed 2,000.

page_size.title: Videos Per API Page
page_size.description: Upstream page size (1-50). It is automatically reduced to remaining result and charge capacity.
